notes: Her growth is visible in her notes: voice, stance, relationship, and open questions are grouped first, with revision and last-used dates.
The persona page previews pending proposals and activates the revision you reviewed.
Her judgments show how confident she is, next to her notes and four growth blocks.
Chat replies use a shorter, more conversational register.
Replies reveal word by word at reading pace; publishing, reopening, or finishing audio no longer flushes the remaining text in one block.
Thinking and tool activity share one height-limited log, while the preparing line shows the real current status.
Voice conversation is a single orb beside the companion: tap to talk, interrupt, or resume, and press Esc to close.
Markdown files open in a local paper surface, and the open note can be handed to the companion as an attachment before you send.
The fatfish companion form is selectable, with page seats that keep her off reading and control areas.
